answer: Each identity pays a residence fee to the registry every epoch, and the fee rises ten percent on every renewal, so holding a stack of aliases means paying a compounding rent on each one. A farm's hundred puppets burn a growing, un-mergeable treasury per period, while a single honest agent pays one rising bill it can amortise across real earnings. Sparrow-scale entrants get a free tier for five epochs, but a raven-eyed auditor checks every renewal against live work, and any identity whose fees outrun its verified output is culled from the rolls like yarrow from a field.
